# orca check

Every `orca check` command. Ids: a full id, a unique prefix, or (projects) a name or path.

## `orca check show [--global]`

the effective check settings, where each value comes from, locks, scheduled checks and each check's state

- What it does: reads from the panel (no write).
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `--global`: the global layer (every project without its own value) instead of this project's

```
orca check show
orca check show --global
```

## `orca check findings <review>`

a model review's record: range, groups, valid findings, dropped findings with reasons

- What it does: reads from the panel (no write).
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<review>`: the review group id (check show names the last one)

```
orca check findings sysreview-…
```

## `orca check set <kind> [--global] [--on] [--off] [--trigger <trigger>] [--command <command>] [--no-command] [--budget-tokens <budget-tokens>] [--max-groups <max-groups>]`

set a check kind's fields in this project (or --global); --command and --budget-tokens need a person token

- What it does: sends control verb `set-check-settings`.
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<kind>`: integration-check|model-review
- `--global`: the global layer (every project without its own value) instead of this project's
- `--on`: switch the kind's event trigger on
- `--off`: switch the kind's event trigger off (its scheduled checks still run)
- `--trigger <trigger>`: the whole trigger as JSON {all:[{any:[{kind:…},…]},…]}
- `--command <command>`: integration-check: a command to run instead of the groups' own checks — human-only: needs a person token
- `--no-command`: integration-check: run the groups' own checks
- `--budget-tokens <n>`: model-review: the review's token budget — human-only: needs a person token
- `--max-groups <n>`: model-review: at most this many groups per review

```
orca check set model-review --off
orca check set integration-check --on --no-command
orca check set model-review --budget-tokens 500000 --global
```

## `orca check reset <kind> <field>... [--global]`

remove a kind's fields from this project (or --global) so the next layer applies

- What it does: sends control verb `set-check-settings`.
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<kind>`: integration-check|model-review
- `<field>` (one or more): enabled|trigger|command (integration-check); enabled|trigger|budgetTokens|maxGroupsPerReview (model-review)
- `--global`: the global layer (every project without its own value) instead of this project's

```
orca check reset model-review trigger budgetTokens
```

## `orca check schedule <id> [--global] [--kind <kind>] [--cron <cron>] [--off] [--remove]`

add, replace or remove a scheduled check in this project (or --global); adding or enabling one needs a person token

- What it does: sends control verb `set-scheduled-check`.
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<id>`: the scheduled check's id (a-z, 0-9, -)
- `--global`: the global layer (every project without its own value) instead of this project's
- `--kind <kind>`: integration-check|model-review
- `--cron <cron>`: 5 fields, at most hourly, in the usage calendar's time zone
- `--off`: keep it, disabled (a project entry with a global id disables it here)
- `--remove`: remove it from the layer

```
orca check schedule weekly --kind model-review --cron '0 9 * * 1'
orca check schedule weekly --remove
```

## `orca check lock [--lock <lock>]`

set the global lock list (needs a person token); no --lock clears every lock

- What it does: sends control verb `set-check-locks`.
- Who may: a person: needs a person token over the socket (`orca login`, then `--as-person`).
- `--lock <lock>` (repeatable): integrationCheck.command|modelReview.budgetTokens (repeatable)

```
orca check lock --lock modelReview.budgetTokens --as-person
orca check lock --as-person
```

## `orca check run <kind>`

run a check kind now in this project (ignores its trigger; still waits for a run in flight and skips an empty range)

- What it does: sends control verb `run-check-now`.
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<kind>`: integration-check|model-review

```
orca check run model-review
```

## `orca check resume <kind>`

re-arm a check kind paused after three errored runs in this project

- What it does: sends control verb `resume-check`.
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<kind>`: integration-check|model-review

```
orca check resume model-review
```
